records.primary_precondition: Every represented state/range, typed width equals end.val-start.val. Invalid range asserts in debug extraction. Original crate and original std wrapping_neg bodies; official pinned nonmonomorphic extraction; no new provider/model.

records.quantified_domain: Every complete public state/inc pair; original blanket method called through unchanged path dependency.

audit_mode: source/evidence reconciliation only; no new build, proof, solver, source edit or publication

noncallable_boundary.constants: DEFAULT_INC literal/source correspondence participates in constructor proofs; not independently counted as callable API. Private MULTIPLIER is a callee constant, not an extra public API.
noncallable_boundary.associated_Error: TryInto preserves the selected actual TryFrom associated Error; blanket TryFrom error Infallible is uninhabited. No arbitrary Rust error type availability is asserted.
